result.title: GlaucomaMarker - Biomarker-Grounded Glaucoma Vision-Language Model
result.summary: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. In the current clinical setting, glaucoma diagnosis is generally conducted by assessing optic disc cupping and asymmetry. Vision-language models (VLMs) have been utilized in recent years for glaucoma, mostly trained on fixed templates or AI-generated captions, as no public text describes the biomarkers. Our proposed framework, GlaucomaMarker, hypothesizes that retinal structural biomarkers can ground glaucoma-based VLMs. It converts public segmentation masks into sentences describing eleven biomarkers, to teach retinal foundation models to read them. We applied this framework to RETFound (GlaucomaMarker-R) and FLAIR (GlaucomaMarker-F), training on 9,778 images that yielded 45,190 image-text pairs. On a real-world clinical cohort, GlaucomaMarker-F detects glaucoma with an AUROC of 0.905, against 0.848 for FLAIR, and both read the biomarkers where baselines stay near random guessing. Since the biomarker text is computed from existing masks, it comes at no extra cost.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作把公开分割掩码转写为描述十一种视网膜生物标志物的句子，用 4.5 万图文对微调 RETFound 与 FLAIR 两个视网膜基础模型，构建以生物标志物为据的视觉语言模型并在真实临床队列上评估青光眼识别与标志物读数能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其由分割掩码派生的结构化文本监督思路，可能为 LVR 中「哪些视觉细节需被保留与被答案使用」的证据筛选与监督设计提供参照，但论文本身不涉及 latent 状态生成或推理期视觉获取，联系较远，需要核查。
